verdict.rationale: Probes found no llms.txt and no markdown versions of the Isaac Sim docs (both returned 404). However, Isaac Lab ships a first-party library of agent skills covering installation, environment creation, RL training and migration, and Isaac ROS offers a dedicated AI agent skill for upgrading ROS 2 nodes. Those skills are agent-oriented guidance you can point an agent at, though only for specific tasks rather than the docs as a whole. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, agent-readable markdown docs, agent-oriented coverage of the full documentation set, and hands-on corroboration that the skills work.
